notes.title: Woodways 1.4.01 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey everybody!
This hotfix addresses an issue that caused some players to not receive Steam Achievements. 
If you experienced such an issue, completing any level (including the introductory level 1) should retroactively net you all the achievements you missed, except the 'Oops!' achievement (which can be easily reproduced in most levels).

Thank you for your support, and good luck on your puzzle solving endeavors!

Sen Games

notes.title: Woodways 1.4.00 Update - Chinese Localization and Sale!
notes.content:
Hey everybody!
We are happy to announce this special update, just in time for the Steam Summer Sale.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32333121/136e88d8945b515001ff022873f15351ca156cab.png[/img]
Recently, Valve had officially announced that it is launching Steam in China. To celebrate, Simplified Chinese is now a supported language in Woodways!
Additionally, you can purchase the game for 30% off during the duration of the Summer Sale!

Have a great summer, and good luck on your puzzle solving endeavors. 谢谢你们!﻿
Nadav, Stav & Elad
Sen Games

notes.title: Woodways 1.3.02 update is live!
notes.content:
Hey there!
The update to version 1.3.02 is live, here are the patch notes:
[list]
[*] Resolved an audio issue that caused volume spikes during transitions between screens.
[*] Optimization to loading times, the game should load noticeably faster.
[*] Slightly smaller file size.
[*] Minor visual tweaks and adjustments.
[/list]
Thanks for your support, and good luck on your puzzle solving endeavors!
Nadav, Stav & Elad
Sen Games
